titleJa: 中1 Lesson 3 — Goal・Language Focus 2・Take Action（宝物クイズ・道案内・p.50–54）
title: M1 L3 — Treasure quiz, LF2, directions & city map (p.50–54)
readingPassages: p.50 — Goal Activity: 宝物クイズをしよう！
My Treasure Quiz — example:
Hint 1: My treasure is big.
Hint 2: It is brown.
Hint 3: I play music on it.
Answer: guitar
Let's Talk（答える人は1回だけ質問）:
Do you use it every day? — Yes, I do.
Is it in the music room? — Maybe.
Can you carry it? — Yes, I can.
Language Focus 2 — まとめ:
be動詞: I am ... / Are you ...? / I am not ...
一般動詞: I like music. / Do you play soccer? / I do not play soccer.
Let's take a picture.
命令文: Play the guitar. / Don't be late. / Be careful.
can: Can you play the guitar? — Yes, I can. / I cannot play the guitar.
疑問詞: what / how many / who / when / where
some / any: I see some birds. / Do you see any birds? / I don't see any birds.
p.53 — Take Action! Talk 1: 道案内（夏海）
Man: Excuse me. How can I get to Crown Cake Shop?
Natsumi: Um, go straight on this street. Then turn left at the second corner.
Man: Straight, then left at the second corner.
Natsumi: Yes. It's on your right.
Man: I see. Thank you.
Expressions: How can I get to ...? / go straight / turn left at ... / It's on your right.
p.54 — Take Action! Read 1: 町の案内図（CITY MAP）
Places: Green Park, City Museum, Thai Restaurant, Central Station, City Hospital, Police Station, Supermarket
Scenario 1 (9:00): lost wallet, speaks Chinese → Police Station
Scenario 2 (noon): lunch, eat in park, Asian food → Thai Restaurant + Green Park (takeout)
Scenario 3 (1:00): basketball, museum ticket, by bike → Green Park
Scenario 4 (3:00): unwell, hospital, no appointment, taxi → City Hospital (call first; taxi stand closed)

items.meaningJa: 私の宝物は大きいです。
それで音楽を演奏します。
それを運べますか。―はい、運べます。

どこに行きたいですか。―屋久島に行きたいです。
